name: Opinly
description:
Opinly connects your AI assistant to your company's competitive and search intelligence, so you can query it and act on it in conversation.

Capabilities:

- Competitive analysis: track competitors and compare keyword and backlink profiles to identify coverage gaps.
- SEO research: search keyword ideas, review rankings and estimated traffic, and analyse backlinks and referring domains.
- AI-search (LLM) visibility: measure how often your brand appears in AI answers versus competitors, by prompt and over time.
- Site audits: review technical issues and page-level findings from the latest crawl.
- Content management: manage your blog end to end — folders, tags, authors, drafts, scheduling, and publishing — with optional sync to a connected CMS (WordPress, Shopify, Wix, Webflow).

All operations are scoped to the companies you own or belong to, and every action is authorised against your organisation role. Read tools never modify your workspace; tools that create, publish, or delete are marked so your assistant can confirm before acting.

An active Opinly subscription is required. See the connector documentation for setup and the full tool reference.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Opinly to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Opinly to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.opinly.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Opinly MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Opinly lists 61 MCP tools, including add_competitor, assign_pages_to_cluster, compare_llm_visibility, create_author, create_cluster, create_folder, create_llm_prompt, create_post, create_tag, delete_cluster, delete_llm_prompt, and delete_tag.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Opinly?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Opinly in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.
Opinly requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Opinly is developed by Opinly. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
